## BILLBOARD_WGSL
const BILLBOARD_WGSL = "\n\nstruct EngineGlobals {\n  logicalSize: vec2f,\n  targetSize: vec2f,\n  time: f32,\n  dt: f32,\n  _pad: vec2f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> globals: EngineGlobals;\nstruct EngineCamera {\n  view: mat4x4f,\n  proj: mat4x4f,\n  view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  camera_pos: vec4f,\n  viewport: vec4f,\n  view_index: u32,\n  _pad0: u32, _pad1: u32, _pad2: u32,\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view: mat4x4f,\n  jitter: vec4f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> camera: EngineCamera;\n\nstruct Billboard {\n  pos: vec4f,\n  size: vec4f,\n  uv: vec4f,\n  color: vec4f,\n  color2: vec4f,\n};\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> billboards: array<Billboard>;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var atlas_sampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var atlas: texture_2d<f32>;\n\nstruct VSOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) uv: vec2f,\n  @location(1) q: vec2f,\n  @location(2) color: vec4f,\n  @location(3) color2: vec4f,\n  @location(4) @interpolate(flat) flags: u32,\n  @location(5) fraction: f32,\n};\nstruct FragOut {\n  @location(0) color: vec4f,\n  @location(1) emissive: vec4f,\n};\n\nfn view_row(r: u32) -> vec3f {\n  return vec3f(camera.view[0][r], camera.view[1][r], camera.view[2][r]);\n}\n\n@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32, @builtin(instance_index) ii: u32) -> VSOut {\n  var o: VSOut;\n  let b = billboards[ii];\n  var corners = array<vec2f, 6>(\n    vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, 1.0),\n    vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, 1.0), vec2f(-1.0, 1.0)\n  );\n  let q = corners[vi];\n  let flags = u32(b.pos.w + 0.5);\n  let half = b.size.xy * 0.5;\n  if ((flags & 1u) != 0u) {\n    var clip = camera.view_proj * vec4f(b.pos.xyz, 1.0);\n    // Logical px \u2192 target px \u2192 NDC, scaled by w so the division leaves the px size intact.\n    let px_per_logical = globals.targetSize / globals.logicalSize;\n    let ndc = (q * half * px_per_logical) / max(camera.viewport.zw, vec2f(1.0)) * 2.0;\n    clip = vec4f(clip.xy + ndc * clip.w, clip.zw);\n    o.clip = clip;\n  } else {\n    var right = view_row(0u);\n    var up = view_row(1u);\n    if ((flags & 2u) != 0u) {\n      let flat = vec3f(right.x, 0.0, right.z);\n      let len = length(flat);\n      right = select(vec3f(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), flat / max(len, 1e-6), len > 1e-6);\n      up = vec3f(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);\n    }\n    let world = b.pos.xyz + right * (q.x * half.x) + up * (q.y * half.y);\n    o.clip = camera.view_proj * vec4f(world, 1.0);\n  }\n  // Canvas uv: v grows downward, so the top of the quad (q.y = 1) samples v0.\n  let t = q * 0.5 + 0.5;\n  o.uv = vec2f(mix(b.uv.x, b.uv.z, t.x), mix(b.uv.w, b.uv.y, t.y));\n  o.q = t;\n  o.color = b.color;\n  o.color2 = b.color2;\n  o.flags = flags;\n  o.fraction = b.size.z;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: VSOut) -> FragOut {\n  var c = in.color;\n  if ((in.flags & 8u) != 0u) {\n    c = select(in.color2, in.color, in.q.x < in.fraction);\n  }\n  // Sampled unconditionally: textureSample needs uniform control flow.\n  let s = textureSample(atlas, atlas_sampler, in.uv);\n  c *= select(vec4f(1.0), s, (in.flags & 4u) != 0u);\n  var o: FragOut;\n  o.color = c;\n  o.emissive = vec4f(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, c.a);\n  return o;\n}\n";

## PARTICLE_COMPUTE_WGSL
const PARTICLE_COMPUTE_WGSL = "\n\nstruct Particle {\n  posVel: vec4f,  // pos.xy, vel.xy (logical px, px/s)\n  c0: vec4f,      // colour at birth (linear, premultiplied by nothing)\n  c1: vec4f,      // colour at death\n  life: vec4f,    // age, lifetime, size at birth, size at death\n  phys: vec4f,    // gravity.xy, drag, emissive\n};\nstruct Sim {\n  dt: f32,\n  floorY: f32,\n  bounce: f32,\n  time: f32,\n  capacity: f32,\n  stretch: f32,\n  spawnCount: f32,\n  _pad: f32,\n};\n\nstruct Spawn {\n  a: vec4f,   // x, y, shapeA, shapeB\n  b: vec4f,   // angle, spread, speedMin, speedMax\n  c: vec4f,   // lifeMin, lifeMax, sizeStart, sizeEnd\n  c0: vec4f,\n  c1: vec4f,\n  d: vec4f,   // gravX, gravY, drag, shapeKind (0 point, 1 circle, 2 rect, 3 line)\n  e: vec4f,   // start, count, seed, emissive\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read_write> particles: array<Particle>;\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> spawns: array<Spawn>;\n@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> sim: Sim;\n\nfn pcg(v: u32) -> u32 {\n  let s = v * 747796405u + 2891336453u;\n  let w = ((s >> ((s >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ s) * 277803737u;\n  return (w >> 22u) ^ w;\n}\nfn rnd(state: ptr<function, u32>) -> f32 {\n  *state = pcg(*state);\n  return f32(*state) / 4294967295.0;\n}\n\n@compute @workgroup_size(64) fn spawn(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3u) {\n  if (f32(gid.y) >= sim.spawnCount) { return; }\n  let cmd = spawns[gid.y];\n  let i = gid.x;\n  if (f32(i) >= cmd.e.y) { return; }\n  let cap = u32(sim.capacity);\n  let idx = (u32(cmd.e.x) + i) % cap;\n  var st = pcg(i ^ pcg(u32(cmd.e.z)));\n\n  var pos = cmd.a.xy;\n  let kind = cmd.d.w;\n  if (kind > 0.5 && kind < 1.5) {\n    let r = sqrt(rnd(&st)) * cmd.a.z;\n    let th = rnd(&st) * 6.2831853;\n    pos += vec2f(cos(th), sin(th)) * r;\n  } else if (kind > 1.5 && kind < 2.5) {\n    pos += (vec2f(rnd(&st), rnd(&st)) - 0.5) * cmd.a.zw;\n  } else if (kind > 2.5) {\n    pos += cmd.a.zw * rnd(&st);\n  }\n  let ang = cmd.b.x + (rnd(&st) - 0.5) * cmd.b.y;\n  let speed = mix(cmd.b.z, cmd.b.w, rnd(&st));\n  let life = mix(cmd.c.x, cmd.c.y, rnd(&st));\n  let sj = 0.7 + 0.6 * rnd(&st);\n\n  var p: Particle;\n  p.posVel = vec4f(pos, vec2f(cos(ang), sin(ang)) * speed);\n  p.c0 = cmd.c0;\n  p.c1 = cmd.c1;\n  p.life = vec4f(0.0, max(life, 1e-3), cmd.c.z * sj, cmd.c.w * sj);\n  p.phys = vec4f(cmd.d.xyz, cmd.e.w);\n  particles[idx] = p;\n}\n\n@compute @workgroup_size(64) fn update(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3u) {\n  let i = gid.x;\n  if (f32(i) >= sim.capacity) { return; }\n  var p = particles[i];\n  if (p.life.x >= p.life.y) { return; }\n  let dt = sim.dt;\n  p.life.x += dt;\n  var v = p.posVel.zw + p.phys.xy * dt;\n  v *= exp(-p.phys.z * dt);\n  var pos = p.posVel.xy + v * dt;\n  if (pos.y > sim.floorY && v.y > 0.0) {\n    pos.y = sim.floorY;\n    v = vec2f(v.x * 0.75, -v.y * sim.bounce);\n  }\n  p.posVel = vec4f(pos, v);\n  particles[i] = p;\n}\n";

## PARTICLE_COUNT_WGSL
const PARTICLE_COUNT_WGSL = "\nstruct CountParams {\n  capacity: u32,\n  stride: u32,\n  lifeAt: u32,\n  posAt: u32,\n  belowY: f32,\n  _a: f32,\n  _b: f32,\n  _c: f32,\n};\nstruct Counts {\n  alive: atomic<u32>,\n  below: atomic<u32>,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read> data: array<vec4f>;\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read_write> counts: Counts;\n@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> params: CountParams;\n@compute @workgroup_size(64) fn count(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3u) {\n  if (gid.x >= params.capacity) { return; }\n  let life = data[gid.x * params.stride + params.lifeAt];\n  if (life.x < life.y) {\n    atomicAdd(&counts.alive, 1u);\n    if (data[gid.x * params.stride + params.posAt].y < params.belowY) {\n      atomicAdd(&counts.below, 1u);\n    }\n  }\n}\n";

## PARTICLE_RENDER_WGSL
const PARTICLE_RENDER_WGSL = "\n\nstruct EngineGlobals {\n  logicalSize: vec2f,\n  targetSize: vec2f,\n  time: f32,\n  dt: f32,\n  _pad: vec2f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> globals: EngineGlobals;\nstruct EngineCamera {\n  view: mat4x4f,\n  proj: mat4x4f,\n  view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  camera_pos: vec4f,\n  viewport: vec4f,\n  view_index: u32,\n  _pad0: u32, _pad1: u32, _pad2: u32,\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view: mat4x4f,\n  jitter: vec4f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> camera: EngineCamera;\n\n\nstruct Particle {\n  posVel: vec4f,  // pos.xy, vel.xy (logical px, px/s)\n  c0: vec4f,      // colour at birth (linear, premultiplied by nothing)\n  c1: vec4f,      // colour at death\n  life: vec4f,    // age, lifetime, size at birth, size at death\n  phys: vec4f,    // gravity.xy, drag, emissive\n};\nstruct Sim {\n  dt: f32,\n  floorY: f32,\n  bounce: f32,\n  time: f32,\n  capacity: f32,\n  stretch: f32,\n  spawnCount: f32,\n  _pad: f32,\n};\n\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> particles: array<Particle>;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var<uniform> sim: Sim;\n\nstruct PVOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) q: vec2f,\n  @location(1) color: vec4f,\n  @location(2) emissive: f32,\n};\nstruct FragOut {\n  @location(0) color: vec4f,\n  @location(1) emissive: vec4f,\n};\n\n@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32, @builtin(instance_index) ii: u32) -> PVOut {\n  var o: PVOut;\n  let p = particles[ii];\n  if (p.life.x >= p.life.y) {\n    o.clip = vec4f(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 1.0);\n    return o;\n  }\n  var corners = array<vec2f, 6>(\n    vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, 1.0),\n    vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(1.0, 1.0), vec2f(-1.0, 1.0)\n  );\n  let q = corners[vi];\n  let t = p.life.x / p.life.y;\n  let size = max(mix(p.life.z, p.life.w, t), 0.0);\n  let vel = p.posVel.zw;\n  let speed = length(vel);\n  var dir = vec2f(1.0, 0.0);\n  if (speed > 1e-3) { dir = vel / speed; }\n  let len = size + speed * sim.stretch;\n  let perp = vec2f(-dir.y, dir.x);\n  let world = p.posVel.xy + dir * (q.x * len * 0.5) + perp * (q.y * size * 0.5);\n  o.clip = camera.view_proj * vec4f(world, 0.0, 1.0);\n  o.q = q;\n  o.color = mix(p.c0, p.c1, t);\n  o.emissive = p.phys.w;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: PVOut) -> FragOut {\n  let d = length(in.q);\n  var a = clamp(1.0 - d, 0.0, 1.0);\n  a = a * a * in.color.a;\n  let c = in.color.rgb * a;\n  var o: FragOut;\n  o.color = vec4f(c, a);\n  o.emissive = vec4f(c * in.emissive, a);\n  return o;\n}\n";

}

## TRAIL_TEXTURED_WGSL
const TRAIL_TEXTURED_WGSL = "\n@group(1) @binding(1) var trailSampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var trailTex: texture_2d<f32>;\n\nfn trail_edge(local_v: f32, softness: f32) -> f32 {\n  let edge = abs(local_v - 0.5) * 2.0;\n  return 1.0 - smoothstep(1.0 - max(softness, 1e-4), 1.0, edge);\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs_main(in: VSOut) -> FragOut {\n  let t = textureSample(trailTex, trailSampler, in.uv);\n  let rgb = in.color.rgb * t.rgb;\n  let a = in.color.a * t.a * trail_edge(in.local.y, in.params.x);\n  var o: FragOut;\n  o.color = vec4f(rgb, a);\n  o.emissive = vec4f(rgb * in.emissive, a);\n  return o;\n}\n";

## TRAIL_WGSL
const TRAIL_WGSL = "\nfn trail_edge(local_v: f32, softness: f32) -> f32 {\n  let edge = abs(local_v - 0.5) * 2.0;\n  return 1.0 - smoothstep(1.0 - max(softness, 1e-4), 1.0, edge);\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs_main(in: VSOut) -> FragOut {\n  let a = in.color.a * trail_edge(in.local.y, in.params.x);\n  var o: FragOut;\n  o.color = vec4f(in.color.rgb, a);\n  o.emissive = vec4f(in.color.rgb * in.emissive, a);\n  return o;\n}\n";

## WGSL_DECAL_BOX
const WGSL_DECAL_BOX = "\nstruct EngineGlobals {\n  logicalSize: vec2f,\n  targetSize: vec2f,\n  time: f32,\n  dt: f32,\n  _pad: vec2f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> globals: EngineGlobals;\nstruct EngineCamera {\n  view: mat4x4f,\n  proj: mat4x4f,\n  view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  camera_pos: vec4f,\n  viewport: vec4f,\n  view_index: u32,\n  _pad0: u32, _pad1: u32, _pad2: u32,\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view: mat4x4f,\n  jitter: vec4f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> camera: EngineCamera;\n\nstruct DecalParams {\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  // normal_bias, fade_edge, offset, multiply (1 = multiply blend)\n  shape: vec4f,\n  // fade at age 0, fade at age 1, pad, pad\n  fade: vec4f,\n};\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> decal: DecalParams;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var decal_sampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var decal_tex: texture_2d<f32>;\n@group(1) @binding(3) var scene_depth: texture_depth_2d;\n\nstruct DecalVertex {\n  @location(0) position: vec3f,\n  @location(3) m0: vec4f,\n  @location(4) m1: vec4f,\n  @location(5) m2: vec4f,\n  @location(6) uv_rect: vec4f,\n  @location(7) color: vec4f,\n  @location(8) life: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct DecalFrame {\n  origin: vec3f,\n  ax: vec3f,\n  ay: vec3f,\n  az: vec3f,\n  normal: vec3f,\n};\n\n// The rows of the world \u2192 local matrix are axis_i / scale_i and -dot(axis_i, origin) / scale_i:\n// local \u2192 world is origin + sum(axis_i * scale_i * local_i).\nfn decal_frame(m0: vec4f, m1: vec4f, m2: vec4f) -> DecalFrame {\n  var f: DecalFrame;\n  let s0 = 1.0 / max(dot(m0.xyz, m0.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s1 = 1.0 / max(dot(m1.xyz, m1.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s2 = 1.0 / max(dot(m2.xyz, m2.xyz), 1e-12);\n  f.ax = m0.xyz * s0;\n  f.ay = m1.xyz * s1;\n  f.az = m2.xyz * s2;\n  f.origin = -(f.ax * m0.w + f.ay * m1.w + f.az * m2.w);\n  f.normal = normalize(m2.xyz);\n  return f;\n}\n\nstruct FragOut {\n  @location(0) color: vec4f,\n  @location(1) emissive: vec4f,\n};\n\nfn decal_out(c: vec4f, alpha: f32) -> FragOut {\n  var o: FragOut;\n  if (decal.shape.w > 0.5) {\n    o.color = vec4f(mix(vec3f(1.0), c.rgb, alpha), 1.0);\n    o.emissive = vec4f(1.0);\n  } else {\n    o.color = vec4f(c.rgb, alpha);\n    o.emissive = vec4f(0.0);\n  }\n  return o;\n}\n\nfn decal_age_fade(life: vec4f) -> f32 {\n  return mix(decal.fade.x, decal.fade.y, clamp(life.x, 0.0, 1.0));\n}\n\nstruct BoxOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) @interpolate(flat) m0: vec4f,\n  @location(1) @interpolate(flat) m1: vec4f,\n  @location(2) @interpolate(flat) m2: vec4f,\n  @location(3) @interpolate(flat) uv_rect: vec4f,\n  @location(4) @interpolate(flat) color: vec4f,\n  @location(5) @interpolate(flat) life: vec4f,\n  @location(6) @interpolate(flat) normal: vec3f,\n};\n\n@vertex fn vs(v: DecalVertex) -> BoxOut {\n  let f = decal_frame(v.m0, v.m1, v.m2);\n  let world = f.origin + f.ax * v.position.x + f.ay * v.position.y + f.az * v.position.z;\n  var o: BoxOut;\n  o.clip = camera.view_proj * vec4f(world, 1.0);\n  o.m0 = v.m0;\n  o.m1 = v.m1;\n  o.m2 = v.m2;\n  o.uv_rect = v.uv_rect;\n  o.color = v.color;\n  o.life = v.life;\n  o.normal = f.normal;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: BoxOut) -> FragOut {\n  let dims = vec2i(textureDimensions(scene_depth));\n  let px = clamp(vec2i(in.clip.xy), vec2i(0), dims - vec2i(1));\n  let d = textureLoad(scene_depth, px, 0);\n  if (d >= 1.0) { discard; }\n  let vp = camera.viewport;\n  let ndc = vec2f(\n    (in.clip.x - vp.x) / vp.z * 2.0 - 1.0,\n    1.0 - (in.clip.y - vp.y) / vp.w * 2.0);\n  let wp = decal.inv_view_proj * vec4f(ndc, d, 1.0);\n  let world = wp.xyz / wp.w;\n  let w4 = vec4f(world, 1.0);\n  let local = vec3f(dot(in.m0, w4), dot(in.m1, w4), dot(in.m2, w4));\n  if (any(abs(local) > vec3f(0.5))) { discard; }\n  // Surface normal from the reconstructed position, turned towards the camera.\n  let n0 = normalize(cross(dpdx(world), dpdy(world)));\n  let n = select(-n0, n0, dot(n0, camera.camera_pos.xyz - world) >= 0.0);\n  if (dot(n, in.normal) < decal.shape.x) { discard; }\n  let uv = in.uv_rect.xy + vec2f(local.x + 0.5, 0.5 - local.y) * in.uv_rect.zw;\n  let c = textureSample(decal_tex, decal_sampler, uv) * in.color;\n  let edge = smoothstep(0.0, max(decal.shape.y, 1e-4), (0.5 - abs(local.z)) * 2.0);\n  return decal_out(c, c.a * edge * decal_age_fade(in.life));\n}\n";

## WGSL_DECAL_DEPTH_COPY
const WGSL_DECAL_DEPTH_COPY = "\n@group(0) @binding(0) var src: texture_depth_2d;\n@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) i: u32) -> @builtin(position) vec4f {\n  let p = vec2f(f32((i << 1u) & 2u), f32(i & 2u));\n  return vec4f(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);\n}\n@fragment fn fs(@builtin(position) pos: vec4f) -> @builtin(frag_depth) f32 {\n  return textureLoad(src, vec2i(pos.xy), 0);\n}\n";

## WGSL_DECAL_QUAD
const WGSL_DECAL_QUAD = "\nstruct EngineGlobals {\n  logicalSize: vec2f,\n  targetSize: vec2f,\n  time: f32,\n  dt: f32,\n  _pad: vec2f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> globals: EngineGlobals;\nstruct EngineCamera {\n  view: mat4x4f,\n  proj: mat4x4f,\n  view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  camera_pos: vec4f,\n  viewport: vec4f,\n  view_index: u32,\n  _pad0: u32, _pad1: u32, _pad2: u32,\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view: mat4x4f,\n  jitter: vec4f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> camera: EngineCamera;\n\nstruct DecalParams {\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  // normal_bias, fade_edge, offset, multiply (1 = multiply blend)\n  shape: vec4f,\n  // fade at age 0, fade at age 1, pad, pad\n  fade: vec4f,\n};\n@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> decal: DecalParams;\n@group(1) @binding(1) var decal_sampler: sampler;\n@group(1) @binding(2) var decal_tex: texture_2d<f32>;\n@group(1) @binding(3) var scene_depth: texture_depth_2d;\n\nstruct DecalVertex {\n  @location(0) position: vec3f,\n  @location(3) m0: vec4f,\n  @location(4) m1: vec4f,\n  @location(5) m2: vec4f,\n  @location(6) uv_rect: vec4f,\n  @location(7) color: vec4f,\n  @location(8) life: vec4f,\n};\n\nstruct DecalFrame {\n  origin: vec3f,\n  ax: vec3f,\n  ay: vec3f,\n  az: vec3f,\n  normal: vec3f,\n};\n\n// The rows of the world \u2192 local matrix are axis_i / scale_i and -dot(axis_i, origin) / scale_i:\n// local \u2192 world is origin + sum(axis_i * scale_i * local_i).\nfn decal_frame(m0: vec4f, m1: vec4f, m2: vec4f) -> DecalFrame {\n  var f: DecalFrame;\n  let s0 = 1.0 / max(dot(m0.xyz, m0.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s1 = 1.0 / max(dot(m1.xyz, m1.xyz), 1e-12);\n  let s2 = 1.0 / max(dot(m2.xyz, m2.xyz), 1e-12);\n  f.ax = m0.xyz * s0;\n  f.ay = m1.xyz * s1;\n  f.az = m2.xyz * s2;\n  f.origin = -(f.ax * m0.w + f.ay * m1.w + f.az * m2.w);\n  f.normal = normalize(m2.xyz);\n  return f;\n}\n\nstruct FragOut {\n  @location(0) color: vec4f,\n  @location(1) emissive: vec4f,\n};\n\nfn decal_out(c: vec4f, alpha: f32) -> FragOut {\n  var o: FragOut;\n  if (decal.shape.w > 0.5) {\n    o.color = vec4f(mix(vec3f(1.0), c.rgb, alpha), 1.0);\n    o.emissive = vec4f(1.0);\n  } else {\n    o.color = vec4f(c.rgb, alpha);\n    o.emissive = vec4f(0.0);\n  }\n  return o;\n}\n\nfn decal_age_fade(life: vec4f) -> f32 {\n  return mix(decal.fade.x, decal.fade.y, clamp(life.x, 0.0, 1.0));\n}\n\nstruct QuadOut {\n  @builtin(position) clip: vec4f,\n  @location(0) uv: vec2f,\n  @location(1) @interpolate(flat) color: vec4f,\n  @location(2) @interpolate(flat) life: vec4f,\n};\n\n@vertex fn vs(v: DecalVertex) -> QuadOut {\n  let f = decal_frame(v.m0, v.m1, v.m2);\n  let world = f.origin + f.ax * v.position.x + f.ay * v.position.y + f.normal * decal.shape.z;\n  var o: QuadOut;\n  o.clip = camera.view_proj * vec4f(world, 1.0);\n  o.uv = v.uv_rect.xy + vec2f(v.position.x + 0.5, 0.5 - v.position.y) * v.uv_rect.zw;\n  o.color = v.color;\n  o.life = v.life;\n  return o;\n}\n\n@fragment fn fs(in: QuadOut) -> FragOut {\n  let c = textureSample(decal_tex, decal_sampler, in.uv) * in.color;\n  return decal_out(c, c.a * decal_age_fade(in.life));\n}\n";

## Water
class Water implements Drawable {
    level: number;
    readonly origin: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    readonly shallowColor: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    readonly deepColor: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    depthFade: number;
    fresnel: number;
    roughness: number;
    waves: WaterWave[];
    foam: WaterFoam | null;
    displace: number;
    opacity: number;
    depthTarget: SceneTarget | null;
    readsDepth: boolean;
    time: number;
    readonly mesh: Mesh;
    constructor(renderer: Renderer, opts?: WaterOptions);
    update(dt: number): void;
    prepare(encoder: GPUCommandEncoder, frame?: Frame): void;
    draw(pass: GPURenderPassEncoder, frame?: Frame): void;
    afterOpaque(_encoder: GPUCommandEncoder, view: ViewInfo): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

## WaterFoam  (type-only)
interface WaterFoam {
    width: number;
    color: ArrayLike<number>;
}

## WaterOptions  (type-only)
interface WaterOptions {
    size?: number | [number, number];
    segments?: number | [number, number];
    level?: number;
    origin?: ArrayLike<number>;
    shallowColor?: ArrayLike<number>;
    deepColor?: ArrayLike<number>;
    depthFade?: number;
    fresnel?: number;
    roughness?: number;
    waves?: WaterWave[];
    foam?: Partial<WaterFoam> | null;
    displace?: number;
    opacity?: number;
    depthTarget?: SceneTarget;
    readsDepth?: boolean;
}

## WaterWave  (type-only)
interface WaterWave {
    scale: number;
    speed: number;
    amplitude: number;
    direction: [number, number];
}
